selection_basis: The planned-state, cross-fitted predicted-UTS concatenation candidate was selected after the local method-development screen. No other architecture may replace it in this run.
research_question: Is the selected state-matched UTS borrowing procedure stable across many target-label draws and two declared tree learners when predicting chemically held-out MPEA yield strength?
claim_guard: Because MPEA outcomes were inspected during method selection, this is a post-selection robustness validation, not an independent confirmation. It may establish resampling stability and estimate the attainable effect on this dataset; it cannot establish prospective discovery or a universal transfer law.

planned_state.description: Composition plus processing, phase family, test mode, test temperature and calculated density; all are declared before the YS endpoint.

leakage_controls: Elemental systems remain intact across development and evaluation.
Each target-training donor feature is predicted by a UTS model excluding its held elemental system and every evaluation system.
The final donor model excludes every evaluation elemental system.
The shuffled donor is regenerated inside every fold.
Measured UTS remains a separately labelled auxiliary-measurement ceiling.
ood_definition: Evaluation elemental systems are ranked by median nearest-neighbor composition distance to each actually labelled target-training draw; Q4 is the most distant quarter.

inference.reported_screen_interval: descriptive t interval across the 60 predeclared model-by-draw runs
inference.primary_interval: two-way cluster bootstrap that resamples elemental systems and frozen model-by-draw runs
